question: 5 years ago, the average age of a committee of 6 members was 42 years. Since then a member aged 71 years (today) has retired and a new member has joined in his place. The average age of the committee today is the same as it was 5 years ago. How old is the new member?
solution: Had nobody changed, the total would have grown by 6 × 5 = 30 years. For the average to stay at 42, the newcomer must be 30 years younger than the one who left: 71 − 30 = 41 years.

solution: The 4 members are now 4 × (38 + 6) = 176 years in all. Adding the child: 181 for 5 people. Average = 181 ÷ 5 = 36.2 years.
questionHi: 6 वर्ष पहले 4 सदस्यों वाले एक परिवार की औसत आयु 38 वर्ष थी। तब से एक बच्चे का जन्म हुआ है, जो अब 5 वर्ष का है। परिवार की वर्तमान औसत आयु क्या है?

question: 4 years ago, the average age of a committee of 7 members was 52 years. Since then a member aged 59 years (today) has retired and a new member has joined in his place. The average age of the committee today is the same as it was 4 years ago. How old is the new member?
solution: Had nobody changed, the total would have grown by 7 × 4 = 28 years. For the average to stay at 52, the newcomer must be 28 years younger than the one who left: 59 − 28 = 31 years.
questionHi: 4 वर्ष पहले 7 सदस्यों वाली एक समिति की औसत आयु 52 वर्ष थी। तब से 59 वर्ष (आज की आयु) के एक सदस्य सेवानिवृत्त हो गए और उनके स्थान पर एक नया सदस्य आया। आज समिति की औसत आयु वही है जो 4 वर्ष पहले थी। नए सदस्य की आयु कितनी है?
solutionHi: कोई बदलाव न होता तो कुल आयु 7 × 4 = 28 वर्ष बढ़ जाती। औसत 52 पर रहने के लिए नया सदस्य जाने वाले से 28 वर्ष छोटा होना चाहिए: 59 − 28 = 31 वर्ष।

question: The average age of 6 men rises by 1 year when two of them, aged 24 and 26 years, are replaced by two women. What is the average age of the two women?
solution: The total rises by 6 × 1 = 6 years. So the women together are 24 + 26 + 6 = 56 years, an average of 56 ÷ 2 = 28 years.
questionHi: 6 पुरुषों की औसत आयु 1 वर्ष बढ़ जाती है जब उनमें से 24 और 26 वर्ष आयु के दो पुरुषों के स्थान पर दो महिलाएँ आ जाती हैं। दोनों महिलाओं की औसत आयु क्या है?
solutionHi: कुल आयु 6 × 1 = 6 वर्ष बढ़ती है। अतः दोनों महिलाओं की कुल आयु 24 + 26 + 6 = 56 वर्ष है, औसत 56 ÷ 2 = 28 वर्ष।

question: The average age of 20 students is 14 years. The average age of 5 of them is 11 years and that of another 4 is 15 years. What is the average age of the remaining students?
solution: Total = 20 × 14 = 280. The two groups: 5 × 11 + 4 × 15 = 115. The other 11 total 165, average 165 ÷ 11 = 15 years.

question: The present ages of A and B are in the ratio 2 : 5. After 5 years, their average age will be 47 years. What is A's present age?
solution: After 5 years their total is 2 × 47 = 94; now it is 94 − 2 × 5 = 84. One ratio part = 84 ÷ 7 = 12, so A = 2 × 12 = 24 years.

question: The captain of a cricket team of 11 players is 26 years old and the wicket-keeper is 6 years older. If the ages of these two are left out, the average age of the other players is 2 years less than the average age of the whole team. What is the average age of the team?
solution: Let the team average be A: 11A = 26 + 32 + 9(A − 2). So 2A = 58 − 18 = 40, and A = 20 years.

question: At the time of their marriage 5 years ago, the average age of a husband and wife was 26 years. Today they have a child aged 4 years. What is the average age of the family now?
solution: The couple now: 2 × (26 + 5) = 62 years in all. With the child: 62 + 4 = 66 for 3 people. Average = 66 ÷ 3 = 22 years.
